    {"name": "technical_platform_stability", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Reliability strongly affects satisfaction.     {"name": "student_engagement_and_motivation_baseline", "analytical_usefulness": 0.78, "source_groundedness": 0.7, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Useful axis to segment respondents. Somewhat more interpretive/inferred than extractive; ED-0001 'requires_external_structure' is a stretch from the text, but overall defensible categorisations."},
    {"name": "developmental_stage_fit", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Largely restates existing grade_level column, limiting new analytical leverage. Values are well grounded (ED-0002 middle_school from 'seventh graders'). Useful mainly if grade_level was missing."},
    {"name": "subject_discipline_and_remote_fit", "analytical_usefulness": 0.82, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Grouping subjects by remote suitability is a strong analytical axis beyond raw subject.   "rationale": "The added columns collectively give rich, distinct analytical axes (delivery mode, synchronous design, community, kinesthetic access, feedback, platform stability, engagement, subject fit) directly serving the query on improving satisfaction.
